description: Synthetic Dutch and English technical dictation references. Expected strings are reference text, not measured recognition output. Literal instructions disambiguate symbols and formatting; no personal recordings or transcripts are included.

cases.spoken: Please open the window and let some fresh air into the room.
cases.expected: Please open the window and let some fresh air into the room.

cases.expected: Ik ga morgen met de trein naar Amsterdam.

cases.spoken: The dash across the square took less than a minute.
cases.expected: The dash across the square took less than a minute.

Installeer het pakket met de letterlijke naam react koppelteken dom.
